request: Casting an ability takes twice its listed mana cost. A successful cast should charge the listed cost once; a rejected cooldown recast must not spend more mana or extend its cooldown. Reproduce and fix this using actual arena casts.
stage: No failure reproduced in tested cases
outcome: No failure reproduced in tested cases
analysis: The prior actual-arena probe passed all 13 assertions: successful casts charged once and cooldown rejections preserved resources. Source shows one mana deduction in Combat.BeginCast, with DexArena.Unit.mana forwarding to Fighter.mana. No failure or repair is established. This follow-up tests rejection after time has elapsed, so an incorrectly restarted cooldown would be observable, while accounting for ordinary mana regeneration.
